# Public font fixtures

These are openly licensed test assets, not private consumer fonts.

- `Graduate-Regular.ttf`: Google Fonts Graduate, downloaded from
  https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/graduate on 2026-09-16.
  Varsity-style TrueType outlines. License: `Graduate-OFL.txt`.
- `SourceSans3-Regular.otf`: Adobe Source Sans 3, downloaded from
  https://github.com/adobe-fonts/source-sans/tree/release/OTF on 2026-09-16.
  Cubic CFF outlines, kerning and ligature coverage. License:
  `SourceSans3-LICENSE.md`.
- `Abel-Regular.ttf`: Google Fonts Abel, downloaded from
  https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/abel on 2026-09-16.
  Curved quadratic TrueType outlines. License: `Abel-OFL.txt`.

Graduate is also packaged in `priv/fonts` as a reproducible documentation font.
Keep each font's license when redistributing it. Tests do not consult system fonts.
